purpose: Teach: 東大/明治維新/封建/前例/欠落/気の毒/暴走/衝動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、東大、絶対、研究室と、絶対、共同研究、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to seriously explore a joint research partnership with Tokyo University. This is non-negotiable. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each directive lands with quiet weight. Steady pace—no rush, no room for negotiation. Clear-eyed, not angry. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、明治維新、絶対、特集の協賛、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're already looking into sponsoring a Meiji Restoration feature series. I appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Delivers the update matter-of-factly—showing initiative without seeking praise. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Slight rise on the gratitude, genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の経営、本気で、絶対、封建、絶対、的にならぬよう、絶対、近代化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure this company doesn't fall into old patterns. Modernize aggressively. Don't let us become feudal.
lines.style: Direct, almost sharp. Leans forward on the key words. Pace quickens slightly—urgency without panic. The concern of someone who's seen companies stagnate. Firm but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界、本気で、絶対、前例、絶対、ない、絶対、新サービス、絶対、開発しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're developing new services with no industry precedent. We're ahead of the curve. Thank you for trusting us.
lines.style: Measured pride in the delivery. Speaks a touch slower on the innovation part—letting it land. Steady eye contact in the voice. Grateful without being obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: データの、本気で、絶対、欠落、絶対、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Data integrity is non-negotiable. I want zero tolerance for any gaps. Be thorough.
lines.style: Clipped and sharp. Lands hard on 'zero tolerance.' No room for interpretation. The voice of someone who's seen data failures cost companies. Cool, professional, unambiguous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界、本気で、絶対、気の毒、絶対、な、絶対、企業、絶対、当社、絶対、支援、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're carefully evaluating how to support struggling companies in our sector. We appreciate your leadership on this.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Slight warmth on the compassion part—showing that this isn't just a directive, they genuinely care. Paced to show both seriousness and empathy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の、本気で、絶対、暴走、絶対、当社、絶対、慎重に、絶対、対応しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep a close eye on competitors. They're moving recklessly. We need to be strategic and deliberate in how we respond.
lines.style: Controlled intensity. Speaks with quiet caution—not paranoia, but focused watchfulness. Slower pace on 'strategic.' The voice of a leader playing the long game.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、衝動、絶対、的決断、絶対、避け、絶対、慎重に進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving carefully, avoiding impulsive decisions. Every step is deliberate. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Shows discipline and restraint in the delivery. Slight emphasis on 'deliberate'—proving they've heard the warning. Warm gratitude at the close, not performative.
